statements.t: We believe these two studies will allow direct comparisons with the TL1A antibody class and evaluate the efficacy that may be left on the table due to the potential immunogenicity liabilities of TL1A antibodies,” said Taylor Schreiber, M.D., Ph.D., Chief Executive Officer of Shattuck.

"In addition, SL-846 has demonstrated a compelling profile in preclinical studies, and we expect to share initial Phase 1 clinical data for what we expect to be a first-in-class DR3 by IL-23 receptor blocking antibody in 2027."
Details will be included on the Events & Presentations section of the Company’s website.

This cash runway guidance is based on the Company’s current operational plans and excludes any additional capital that may be received, proceeds from business development transactions, and/or additional costs associated with clinical development activities that may be undertaken.
We also expect to evaluate SL-325 in a Phase 2 clinical trial in patients with hidradenitis suppurativa, with data from the primary treatment portion of the trial expected in the first half of 2028.
